sections.title: Identity verification
sections.text: Before opening an account, the onboarding team must verify the customer's identity and retain the verification evidence. Electronic identity verification must use the approved e-KYC service. Exceptions require Compliance approval before activation.

sections.title: Customer review frequency
sections.text: High-risk customer files must be reviewed at least every 12 months. Other customer files must be reviewed at least every 36 months. A material change in identity, ownership or risk triggers an additional review.

sections.title: e-KYC oversight
sections.text: The Board receives a quarterly report on e-KYC exceptions and performance. This sample policy does not specify Board approval of the overall e-KYC risk appetite and internal framework.

sections.title: Identity verification
sections.text: Before opening an account, the onboarding team must verify the customer's identity and retain the verification evidence. Electronic identity verification must use the approved e-KYC service.

sections.title: Customer review frequency
sections.text: High-risk customer files must be reviewed at least every 24 months. Other customer files must be reviewed at least every 36 months.

sections.title: e-KYC oversight
sections.text: Compliance receives an annual report on e-KYC exceptions and performance. This sample policy does not specify Board approval of the overall e-KYC risk appetite and internal framework.

sections.title: Authentication
sections.text: All privileged accounts must use multi-factor authentication. Shared administrator accounts are not permitted unless an approved emergency-access procedure records the individual user and reason.

sections.title: Access review
sections.text: System owners must review privileged access every 90 days and keep a record of approvals and removals. Access for departing employees must be revoked on their last working day.

sections.title: Evidence retention
sections.text: Privileged-access review records must be retained for two years. The IT Security Team owns this sample policy and reviews it annually.

sections.title: Internal escalation
sections.text: Employees must report suspected security incidents to the Security Operations Team within one hour of discovery. The team must record the discovery time, affected systems and immediate containment actions.

sections.title: External reporting
sections.text: Compliance determines whether an incident requires external reporting after reviewing the applicable source requirements. This sample policy does not define a BNM reporting deadline.

sections.title: Review and ownership
sections.text: The Security Operations Team must complete a lessons-learned review within ten working days after incident closure and assign owners to corrective actions.
